title: The secret Kratos hid from Atreus in God of War
subject: kratos
description:
Should Kratos have told Atreus sooner? 👇

The truths Kratos and Faye kept from their son, and the name hidden in Jötunheim. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Kratos hid two secrets from his son. His wife hid a third.
He never told Atreus that his father was a god, or what he had done in Greece.
Then Atreus fell gravely ill, his body fighting a godhood he didn't know he had.
Only then did Kratos tell him the truth. But that's not the biggest secret.
His late mother, Faye, was a giant.
And at the peak of Jötunheim, a mural revealed the name she'd really given their son: Loki.
